Method of Attack: Hijacking SOHO devices to blend malicious activity within legitimate network traffic
Using compromised routers and IP cameras to create a covert data transfer network
Command-and-control (C2) server communication to control botnet devices
Uninstalling botnet VPN component to prevent further attacks
Discoverer: Lumen Technologies' Black Lotus Labs team
Attack Vector: Exploitation of vulnerable SOHO routers that reached end-of-life status without security patches
Indicators of Compromise: Deleted KV Botnet malware from routers
